value.rationale: A motivated quantitative tradeoff in a standard lossy-photon preparation process is completely classified: entropy is maximal at rate equal to the loss rate, while Wigner negativity requires a strictly larger rate for even target number states but immediately above the same rate for odd target states. The explicit two-photon cubic and annular transition quantify a nontrivial parity distinction, not a renamed fixed-loss threshold. Rate-order proof is all-index; even higher-index thresholds are characterized without claiming a closed formula.
